description_en: Deletes live snapshot files. You can choose to delete only the records or delete both the records and the original OSS files
description_zh: 调用DeleteLiveSnapshotFiles删除实时截图文件，可选择只删除记录或同时删除原始OSS文件
name: DeleteLiveSnapshotFiles

parameters.help_en: The ID of the snapshot job
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The list of creation timestamps. A maximum of 200 entries can be deleted at a time
parameters.help_zh: 创建时间戳列表。单次最多删除200个
parameters.name: create_timestamp_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to delete the original files. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否删除原始文件，默认是false
parameters.name: delete_original_file
